title: WHEN A SINNER COMES
stanzas: When a sinner comes as a sinner may, There's joy, there's joy; when He turns to God in the gospel way, There's joy, there's joy
When a soul is born in the kingdom bright, There's joy, there's joy; When he walks by faith in the gospel light; There's joy, there's joy
When a sinner comes to the river side, There's joy, there's joy; when he walks by faith in the gospel light; There's joy, there's joy.
chorus: There's joy among the angels, and there harps with music ring, When a sinner comes repenting bending low before our King.
